title: Object Storage: payment methods
content:

| Contract tier | Payment methods |

| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | payment methods: ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | payment methods: ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | payment methods: ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | payment methods: ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | payment methods: ach; wire; card |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the payment methods entry is ach; wire; card.
